results.title: Shelby
results.overview: In the depths of the Louisiana swamps, Shelby lives an extraordinary life of adventure and survival. This documentary unveils his mysterious world of underwater logging, treasure hunting, and wild encounters where myth and reality blur together.

results.title: Seekers of Infinite Love
results.overview: Kayla Bachman, an author who struggles with emotional connection, Zach Bachman, a lawyer who dreams of being a folk singer and Wes Bachman, a graphic novelist / gambling & pill addict, meet to discuss their younger sister Scarlett who joined a cult in Kentucky. Zach and his dysfunctional and absent parents have hired cult deprogrammer Rick Delacroix to help them rescue Scarlett. They embark on a roadtrip to save their sister, and bring their family together.

results.title: My Stepdaughter's Big Tits
results.overview: Not easy when your stepdaughter's got such a perfect pair. Especially when she plays the naughty little bad girl. 100% natural but a lot more than stepmom's. Way too XXL for that cheerleader uniform.

results.title: Now, Irving Rapper
results.overview: Irving Rapper is, in many ways, Hollywood's forgotten man. After getting his start as a "dialogue director" at Warner Bros. in the mid 30's, he became synonymous with the studio's "women's pictures" and rose in prominence as one of Bette Davis's most consistent collaborators, including on her biggest commercial success, Now Voyager (1942). He was a rebel who led the studio in suspensions for chronically refusing to direct the scripts handed to him by the brass, waiting instead for material that better suited his interests and thematic preoccupations. He was also one in a secretive fraternity of gay directors who had to conceal their identities and shield their private lives from potential public ruination. Daniel Kremer takes you through an unexamined and misunderstood life of a man of great artistic inclination who expressed his innermost yearnings covertly through his work in motion pictures.

results.title: Karmakhya
results.overview: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

results.title: Pithead
results.overview: Amidst an icy dreamscape, a woman takes refuge in a black metal karaoke bar. Outside, she finds a lone penguin stranded in a tree, cut off from its colony.

results.title: After Hours
results.overview: A young woman is forced to put her night on hold when her father calls in a favor, but with a killer on the loose, the night takes a turn she never saw coming.

results.title: Unacceptable
results.overview: A drama based on a true story that spans decades, exploring themes of love, friendship, courage, and societal change. The story begins in 1981 with Ted, a frail elderly man, reflecting on his life as he celebrates a landmark legal ruling with his nephew Simon, Simon’s partner Mark, and his lifelong friend Catherine. Flashbacks reveal Ted’s youth in 1940s Melbourne, where he stood up against homophobia and violence, forming a complex bond with Catherine and Leo.

results.title: Black Yard The Movie
results.overview: For Mukha and Bob, childhood is over. Now they find themselves on opposite sides of the bars: one is planning an escape, while the other is forced to cover for him. The two friends must make a difficult choice between their conscience and the unwritten rules of the criminal underworld, because their decision will determine which of them walks free and which remains a prisoner of the past.

results.title: Erar Poddo
results.overview: A touching romantic drama where love blooms like a lotus through pain, patience, and the quiet beauty of heartfelt emotions.

results.title: One Night in June
results.overview: One Night In June is a dark drama that introduces Lydia and John, as they face a crossroads in their relationship. Through lies, betrayal and vengeful rage they both commit acts they cannot un-do. John is left with an ultimatum that will change his and Lydia's life forever. This gripping short film confronts the nature of the human experience. Our mistakes, our choices, how they impact the ones we love, and the extreme consequences we face.

results.title: The Theft of the Caravaggio
results.overview: Orpheus wakes to discover a priceless Caravaggio painting stolen from St. John's Cathedral in Valletta while under his watch. With the city on edge, a detective is brought in from Washington to aid the local police in solving the case.

results.title: The Leading Role
results.overview: A documentary about Ukrainian actors who, when the war began, left the stage and joined the Armed Forces of Ukraine. The camera explores how creative professionals adapt to an environment where every decision carries irreversible consequences.

results.title: Al Baraneya
results.overview: Pregnant Amal lives together with her family in Al Baraneya, a village outside Cairo, surrounded by jasmine fields. Their chaotic yet loving way of life is upset when a landowner offers to buy their land. The pressure to sell divides the family and doubts begin to grow. When Amal’s cousin Rania visits from Cairo, she captivates Amal and her younger sisters with her modern lifestyle: jeans, TikTok videos, and lively city stories. Amal starts to question the life that seems to have been laid out for her and dreams of moving to Cairo. Now that the potential sale of the land offers the prospect of a future in the city, the family’s unshakable faith in their own life in the village starts to waver.

results.title: ROH Global Wars - Cincinatti
results.overview: ROH x CMLL x Stardom Global Wars, promoted as Global Wars Cincinnati was a professional wrestling event produced and co-promoted by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH), the Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), and the Japanese women's wrestling promotion World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the 23rd Global Wars event and took place on June 10 and June 11, 2026 at the Andrew J. Brady Music Center in Cincinnati, Ohio and aired on June 18, 2026 and part two aired on June 25, 2026 as a special episode of Ring of Honor Wrestling.

results.title: Waiting
results.overview: On Sunday afternoons, Mr. Durval waits for a call from his son.

results.title: Against Nature
results.overview: After many years away, Jonás returns to the countryside to start work as a stonemason. In a place marked by the harshness of life, he opens himself up to something intangible – a force that permeates the landscape, bodies and time itself. An evocatively told story of a silent man whose enigmatic nature stems from the dark side of humanity and from his contact with the sacred, the film moves along the boundary between the physical and the spiritual.

results.title: Anthony
results.overview: Set along the coastal shores of Jaffna, the story follows a fisherman and his family  whose lives are inseparably tied to the sea. As he struggles to balance his responsibilities toward his profession and his family, a tender love story unfolds, shaping his choices and testing his values. Daily life within the fishing community  its hardships, traditions, and unspoken bonds, forms the backdrop of the narrative. When personal desires begin to clash with family expectations, the protagonist is forced to confront sacrifice, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Through moments of romance, conflict, and emotional depth, the film reveals the  strength of family ties and the resilience of a community that survives by trusting the sea and each other.
